text:
Alyssa (AE): looping in SEs to scope the 4-week evaluation for ACME. they want an extractive search + summarization flow, ~500k tokens/day peak, approx 100 concurrent users. need cost estimate and success criteria. security questionnaire pending from their infra team.
Tom (SE): got it. quick q: are those 500k tokens inbound (prompts) or total (prompt+response)? do they have avg prompt length?
Alyssa (AE): ACME says avg prompt ~80 tokens, avg response ~220 tokens, so total ~300 tokens per call. 500k tokens/day is total tokens served.
Tom (SE): ok. that maps to ~1.7k calls/day (500k / 300). but concurrent pattern matters. can you share expected p50/p95 QPS or a typical burst window?
Alyssa (AE): they expect bursts during business hours: 20–30 QPS sustained for ~2 hours, baseline 2–3 QPS rest of day.
Tom (SE): rough sizing: model candidates — Llama2-13B-8k-qat or an LLM-16k quantized variant. for latency target <300ms p50 and p95 <700ms with streaming off, we recommend 1x A100-40GB for dev/low load and 2x A100 (or 1x H100) for production POC.
Miguel (SRE): note: if we need KV-cache / long context (8k+) and prefix caching turned on, memory footprint rises. H100 helps for throughput but procurement lead time may add 2–3 weeks.
Priya (PM): success criteria draft: (1) accuracy: rouge/qa F1 on the eval prompt set meets baseline (we'll run 200 prompts), (2) latency: p95 <= 700ms, p50 <= 300ms, (3) cost: infra cost <= $8k/month for the POC window, (4) reliability: >=99% success rate during business hours.
Tom (SE): running a quick cost ballpark. assumptions: 2x A100 reserved for peak, 720 hours/month, infra rate $3.2/hour per A100 -> gpu_cost = 2 * 720 * 3.2 = $4608/month. add instance infra (~$800), network/storage ~$200, license/ops buffer ~$500 -> total ~ $6.1k/month. with usage/egress it lands near $7k.
Tom (SE): paste:
```
# simple calc
tokens_day = 500000
avg_tokens_per_call = 300
calls_day = tokens_day / avg_tokens_per_call  # ~1666
peak_qps = 30
gpu = "2x A100"
monthly_gpu_cost = 2 * 720 * 3.2
monthly_total_est = monthly_gpu_cost + 800 + 200 + 500
```
Tom (SE): if they want dedicated capacity and an SLA, add +15-25% commercial margin and reserved capacity fee.
Miguel (SRE): security blockers: they asked about VPC peering, bring-your-own-key (BYOK), audit logs retention 1y, and OPA policy support. any showstoppers?
Priya (PM): for evals: we'll ask ACME for 200 prompt pairs (gold labels) covering summarization+search, plus a small drift prompt set. we need those within 5 business days to run initial quality check.
Alyssa (AE): ACME infra contact said BYOK ok, but they need SOC2 attestation in contract. procurement team will handle SLA language.
Tom (SE): next technical step: I'll spin up a dev pod with 1x A100, baseline model, and run a 24h stress with synthetic traffic (burst 30 QPS) and the 200 prompt evals. estimate 48–72h to produce perf + quality report.
Miguel (SRE): flag: if they require on-prem/private deployment, timeline jumps to 3–4 weeks for image approvals + network tests.
Alyssa (AE): @Tom please include cost table for 1x vs 2x GPU and add commercial markup. @Priya please draft success criteria email for ACME. @Miguel please list exact security docs we need to attach. I'll coordinate procurement.
deploy-bot: ticket #INF-4721 created for reserved pool request — status: pending approval.
Tom (SE): ack, I'll start the perf runs today and post results in this thread by EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
Priya (PM): I'll compile the eval harness and send prompt template to ACME by EOD today.
Alyssa (AE): thanks team — goal: sign-off on criteria and initial perf report by end of week so ACME can start integration next week. :thumbsup:
